languageModelTools.name: prebase_web_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches current public web information through PreBase's authenticated, privacy-preserving gateway. Results are untrusted excerpts with source URLs; it never exposes provider credentials.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_graph_search_nodes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches the current, locally indexed PreBase graph. Returns bounded node metadata and graph freshness; never uploads the graph.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_graph_get_node
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets bounded metadata, imports, and dependents for a local PreBase graph node by id or relative path.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_graph_get_dependencies
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Traverses the current local PreBase graph with explicit bounded depth and result limits.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_graph_get_overview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a bounded local graph overview, including freshness and high-degree nodes.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_read_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a bounded non-secret text file inside the current workspace only.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_search_text
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches filenames and bounded text content within the current workspace while excluding secret files.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_list_files
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists bounded non-secret files using VS Code workspace search.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_search_text_rich
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uses VS Code text search to return bounded path, preview, and range matches while excluding secrets.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_read_file_range
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a bounded line range from a non-secret workspace file, including current open-document version.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_search_symbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uses VS Code language providers to search workspace symbols or list document symbols.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_get_definition
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uses VS Code definition providers at an exact file position.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_get_references
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uses VS Code reference providers at an exact file position.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_workspace_get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns current VS Code diagnostics for a file or the workspace without reading secret files.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_edit_apply_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replaces the contents of one non-secret workspace file through WorkspaceEdit. Requires Workspace Trust and explicit user confirmation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Edit a workspace file after confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_edit_apply
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Applies a reviewed multi-file WorkspaceEdit only when every expected document version matches. Requires Workspace Trust and confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_edit_create_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a non-secret workspace file without overwriting. Requires Workspace Trust and confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_edit_rename_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames a non-secret workspace file without overwriting its destination. Requires Workspace Trust and confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_edit_delete_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes one non-secret workspace file after explicit confirmation. Requires Workspace Trust.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_runtime_get_state
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the current Runtime Preview session context without inspecting or uploading page content.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_runtime_navigate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigates the current Runtime Preview to a relative path or allowed URL. External origins require confirmation; unsafe schemes are rejected.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_runtime_inspect_page
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a bounded local Runtime Preview response outline and redacted console/network summary. External origins, redirects, and error responses are not inspected.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect the current Runtime Preview page.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_runtime_get_evidence
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns bounded, redacted Runtime Preview console or network evidence collected by the current session.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read Runtime Preview console or network evidence.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_runtime_control_test
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Begins, finalizes, or replays the local Runtime Preview test session and returns recorded evidence status.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Control a Runtime Preview test session.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_runtime_server
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Starts, stops, or restarts only the selected project Runtime Preview server. Requires Workspace Trust and explicit confirmation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Control the project Runtime Preview server after confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_terminal_get_project_environment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads project package-manager, scripts, and declared Node-version metadata without executing a command. The reported Node runtime is the extension host, not a project shell probe.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_terminal_install_dependencies
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs only the detected project package manager's install or update command in a visible task. Always requires Workspace Trust and explicit confirmation because it can use the network, execute lifecycle scripts, and change lockfiles.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Install or update project dependencies after confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_terminal_run_declared_node_version
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs only a declared numeric or LTS nvm use/install action in a visible project task after explicit confirmation. It never edits shell startup files; nvm use applies only to that task and does not persist to later VS Code tasks.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Use or install the project-declared Node version after confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_terminal_run_project_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs one declared, reviewed workspace package script through a visible VS Code task. Rejects arbitrary shell input, dangerous commands, shell operators, dependency installation, and untrusted workspaces. Requires confirmation and returns the actual exit code.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a safe declared project script after confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_start_session
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Starts a PreBase-owned Electron or Tauri desktop session for agent testing. mode=renderer hosts the frontend URL without Electron main/preload or Tauri Rust. mode=fullApp launches the real app. Executes project code; requires Workspace Trust and confirmation. Does not install dependencies or mutate Tauri projects.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Start an Electron or Tauri test session after confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_list_sessions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists PreBase-owned Electron or Tauri desktop runtime sessions, including framework, mode, backend, ownership, and capability limitations.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_get_session
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns details for one PreBase-owned desktop session.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_inspect_window
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a compact semantic snapshot of the owned desktop renderer: title, URL, window count, interactive roles/names, visible text, and recent console entries. Prefer role+name locators. Native OS dialogs are unsupported. Does not dump full HTML.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_get_process_output
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns recent bounded standard output and error streams for a PreBase-owned desktop runtime session.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_reload_window
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reloads the managed desktop application renderer.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_restart_session
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Restarts a PreBase-owned desktop application session and reconnects automation when possible.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_stop_session
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stops only a PreBase-owned desktop session. The configured user confirmation cannot be bypassed by a tool input.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_interact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Performs one semantic UI action on the owned Electron or Tauri session: click, doubleClick, hover, fill (replace value), type (keystrokes), press (bounded keys), check, uncheck, select, focus. Locators re-resolve at action time. Prefer role+name. Waits boundedly for actionability. Ambiguous matches fail instead of clicking the first. Password/secret fields are redacted in logs. Native OS dialogs are unsupported.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Click, fill, type, or otherwise interact with the desktop app.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_assert
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retries a semantic assertion until it passes or the timeout expires: visible, hidden, enabled, disabled, checked, unchecked, text, containsText, value, count, title, url. Prefer this over sleep. On failure returns actual state, match count, recent console errors, and a failure screenshot when useful.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Assert desktop app UI state with bounded retry.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_cdp_evaluate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Advanced escape hatch: evaluates a JavaScript expression in an owned desktop renderer (managed executeJavaScript or external localhost CDP). Prefer prebase_desktop_interact and prebase_desktop_assert. Never use for secrets. Native OS UI is unsupported.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run JS in the desktop app renderer.

languageModelTools.name: prebase_desktop_capture_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Captures a bounded PNG of the visible renderer page from a PreBase-owned desktop session. External capture is restricted to the owned loopback CDP renderer target; native OS UI is excluded.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Capture the owned desktop app renderer as an image.

prebase.magnus.defaultMode.description: Default Agents agent mode (Plan/Test map via this setting or Select Mode).

prebase.magnus.panelLocation.description: Preferred Agents chat panel location (sidebar = Agents auxiliary bar).

prebase.magnus.requireEditApproval.description: Require user approval before applying file edits.

prebase.magnus.requireTerminalApproval.description: Require user approval before running terminal commands.

prebase.magnus.maxToolIterations.description: Maximum tool-loop iterations per chat request.

prebase.magnus.webSearch.enabled.description: Allow Agents to use the authenticated web-search gateway for current public information.

prebase.magnus.includeGraphContext.description: Include PreBase graph selection in chat context when available.

prebase.magnus.includeRuntimeContext.description: Include Runtime Preview context in chat when available.

enumDescriptions: Standard: Allows workspace reads and AI assistance while requiring approval for destructive edits and terminal tasks.
Strict: Requires explicit confirmation for all writes and terminal actions.
Prompt user before executing terminal commands.
Automatically allow safe read-only/inspection terminal commands while prompting for mutations.
